verdict.rationale: Qapita is a SaaS equity-management platform, so a documented public API is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions an API, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. An llms.txt file exists, but it only describes the marketing site and is not a programmatic interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
